copy_path_comparison.source_path: Pinned BoringSSL ssl/ssl_lib.cc SSL_peek invokes OPENSSL_memcpy; crypto/internal.h defines it as direct memcpy(dst,src,n) after a zero-length check.

limitations: Whole baseline and stock DSOs are not byte-identical; the local hidden memcpy body is byte-identical and both BoringSSL callsites target it.
CMake/Ninja versions are the versions installed in this WSL environment; upstream workflow does not pin them.

Initial configure/build failure from host OpenSSL pkg-config extras is retained. Recovery used a fresh curl CMake cache and PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR limited to pinned dependency metadata; it did not alter source, toolchain target or compile/link options.
No candidate patch or timing evidence is in this baseline record.
